governing_rule: An exact IA body must itself have a native primitive expansion; primitive premises alone are insufficient.

admitted.body: For all packet-local Boolean values x,y, represented allowed-orientation membership holds iff x=y.
The concrete six-variable 4x4 zero-delta system holds iff all six Boolean variables are 0 or all six are 1.
The target-split five-variable 5x4 Boolean system holds iff the assignment is 00001 or 11110.
On each of the two shortest 5x4 routes, the route phase relation equals the final-state P0 residual-token-197700 membership-bit relation.
Boolean XOR output is invariant when both inputs are simultaneously complemented.
Every satisfying target-split 5x4 assignment has target/source XOR equal to the represented final residual bit on each route.
The two shortest 5x4 route phase bits XOR to 1.
The two explicit 4x4 route phase bits XOR to 0.
